summary: Motion that can be proposed, from the micro-settings of controls to signature moments. Durations and curves follow premium-craft; every entry has a reduced-motion version.

entries.what: Things that appear start fast and slow down at the end, so they feel responsive.
entries.use_when: Every entrance: menus, dialogs, toasts, content.
entries.avoid_when: Movement from one place to another (use ease-in-out).
entries.build: A custom curve such as cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); the CSS keyword ease-out is weak.

entries.what: Something already on screen that moves to another place accelerates then slows down.
entries.use_when: Reordering, a panel sliding to a new position, a carousel step.
entries.avoid_when: Entrances and exits.
entries.build: cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1) or a spring with no bounce.

entries.what: Dropdowns and popovers open in about 180 ms: fast enough to feel instant, slow enough to be seen.
entries.use_when: Every dropdown, popover and tooltip.
entries.avoid_when: Nothing.
entries.build: transition: transform 180ms, opacity 180ms with an ease-out curve; tooltips about 125 ms.

entries.what: A button shrinks slightly while pressed, like a physical key.
entries.use_when: Buttons and cards that can be pressed.
entries.avoid_when: Text links; actions started from the keyboard.
entries.build: :active { transform: scale(0.97) } with a 100 ms transition (range 0.96 to 0.98).

entries.what: Items of a list appear one after the other, 30 to 50 ms apart.
entries.use_when: First appearance of a list, a menu or search results.
entries.avoid_when: Lists that update often; more than about ten items (the rest appear together).
entries.build: animation-delay: calc(var(--i) * 40ms) or Motion's stagger. With prefers-reduced-motion: no movement, a plain state change.

entries.what: A popover grows from the button that opened it and shrinks back into it on close.
entries.use_when: Dropdowns, popovers, context menus.
entries.avoid_when: Dialogs centred on screen (they scale from about 0.8 at the centre).
entries.build: transform-origin from the popover library's variable (Radix: --radix-popover-content-transform-origin), start at scale 0.95, never 0.

entries.what: Things leave about 20 % faster and more quietly than they arrived.
entries.use_when: Every exit.
entries.avoid_when: Nothing.
entries.build: Exit with opacity and about 4 px of blur, 20 % shorter than the entrance.

entries.what: Content appears from a slight blur and offset, which hides imperfect frames and feels smoother.
entries.use_when: Entrances of content blocks and icon swaps.
entries.avoid_when: Large surfaces on low-end phones (blur is costly).
entries.build: From translateY(8px), filter: blur(8px), opacity 0; icon swaps with blur(2px).

entries.what: The old state fades out while the new one fades in, both visible for a moment.
entries.use_when: Swapping an icon (copy → check), a label, an image.
entries.avoid_when: Moving an element (move it instead).
entries.build: Two layers with opacity, scale and blur together; or a View Transition on the root.

entries.what: When a card becomes a page or a thumbnail a viewer, the element itself moves and grows.
entries.use_when: Lists to detail, galleries, tab indicators.
entries.avoid_when: Unrelated screens.
entries.build: View Transitions (view-transition-name) or Motion's layoutId.

label.fr: Pas de rebond sur les transitions simples

entries.what: Routine transitions settle without overshoot; bounce is kept for gestures and rare moments.
entries.use_when: Every routine state change.
entries.avoid_when: Nothing.
entries.build: Springs with bounce 0 by default, about 0.15 for some life on a gesture.

entries.what: A short single pulse confirms that something worked: a saved state, a payment, a completed step.
entries.use_when: Rare, meaningful successes.
entries.avoid_when: Frequent actions; a dot pulsing forever (no state).
entries.build: scale 1 → 1.05 → 1 in under 300 ms, once. With prefers-reduced-motion: no movement, a plain state change.
checks: sw look: LOOK-PULSE flags endless pulses

entries.what: An element travelling far across the screen follows a slight curve, as objects do, instead of a straight line.
entries.use_when: Add-to-cart flights, a card thrown to a new column, a floating notch.
entries.avoid_when: Short moves and routine transitions.
entries.build: offset-path with a curve, or animate x and y with different easings. With prefers-reduced-motion: no movement, a plain state change.

entries.what: An element released by the finger keeps the speed of the gesture and settles, so it feels physical.
entries.use_when: Sheets, carousels, cards thrown or swiped.
entries.avoid_when: Clicks and keyboard actions.
entries.build: Pass the gesture's velocity to a spring (Motion, react-spring, Vaul for sheets); about 0.45 s, no bounce.

entries.what: Dragging past a limit meets growing resistance, then the element springs back.
entries.use_when: Sheets, carousels, sliders, pull to refresh.
entries.avoid_when: Page scrolling (the system already does it).
entries.build: Past the limit, the shown displacement is overshoot × size × 0.55 / (size + 0.55 × |overshoot|), so it slows as it grows (Motion: dragElastic about 0.2); about 10 px of movement before a drag commits; then a spring back to the limit.

entries.what: Moving from one page to another crossfades or slides, with shared elements carried over.
entries.use_when: Portfolios, editorial sites, galleries, shops between list and product.
entries.avoid_when: Apps where speed matters more than continuity.
entries.build: Cross-document View Transitions (@view-transition { navigation: auto }) with view-transition-name on shared elements. With prefers-reduced-motion: no movement, a plain state change.

entries.what: Sections or images fade in as they enter the screen.
entries.use_when: One orchestrated moment per page on marketing pages.
entries.avoid_when: Every section (flagged as generic), app and reading screens.
entries.build: IntersectionObserver or animation-timeline: view(); once, not on each pass. With prefers-reduced-motion: no movement, a plain state change.
checks: sw look: LOOK-ANIMATE-ALL when on every section

entries.what: A thin bar at the top fills as the reader goes down the article.
entries.use_when: Long articles and guides.
entries.avoid_when: Short pages and apps.
entries.build: animation-timeline: scroll(root) on transform: scaleX(); no JavaScript needed.

entries.what: Layers move at different speeds while scrolling, giving depth.
entries.use_when: Brand, travel, event and storytelling pages, with restraint.
entries.avoid_when: Reading and app screens; text layers.
entries.build: Scroll-driven animations on transform only. With prefers-reduced-motion: no movement, a plain state change.

entries.what: A section stays pinned while its content changes step by step with the scroll.
entries.use_when: Product tours, data stories, launches.
entries.avoid_when: Anything people need to scan quickly; phones with long pinned sections.
entries.build: position: sticky with steps; a third of the screen per step at most. With prefers-reduced-motion: no movement, a plain state change.

entries.what: Vertical scrolling moves a row of cards sideways inside a pinned section.
entries.use_when: Portfolios, timelines, collections.
entries.avoid_when: Essential content (people miss it).
entries.build: Sticky container plus a scroll-driven translateX; a visible way to skip it.

entries.what: Words or lines of a headline appear one after the other.
entries.use_when: One headline per page on brand and launch pages.
entries.avoid_when: Body text, app screens.
entries.build: Split into spans, about 80 ms between words, never letter by letter on long text. With prefers-reduced-motion: no movement, a plain state change.

entries.what: A row of logos or words scrolls continuously.
entries.use_when: Real client logos or a short slogan on a brand page.
entries.avoid_when: Invented logos (BRD-01); without a pause control when it lasts over 5 seconds.
entries.build: CSS animation on transform with a duplicated row; pause on hover and focus, a pause button, stopped with prefers-reduced-motion.

entries.what: A button is slightly attracted by the pointer when it comes near.
entries.use_when: Agencies, portfolios, creative studios, on one or two buttons.
entries.avoid_when: Touch screens, forms, apps.
entries.build: @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) only; translate up to about 8 px with a spring. With prefers-reduced-motion: no movement, a plain state change.

entries.what: The pointer is replaced or followed by a shape that reacts to what is under it.
entries.use_when: Creative portfolios and studios.
entries.avoid_when: Any site where people must click precisely; touch screens.
entries.build: Keep the system cursor visible or use cursor: url(); follow with transform in requestAnimationFrame; hidden with reduced motion.

entries.what: Characters shuffle before settling into the final word.
entries.use_when: Developer tools, tech launches, a short label.
entries.avoid_when: Body text and anything read by screen readers during the effect.
entries.build: Keep the real text in the DOM (aria-label) and animate a decorative copy. With prefers-reduced-motion: no movement, a plain state change.

entries.what: A number counts up to its value when it comes into view.
entries.use_when: One real, sourced figure.
entries.avoid_when: Invented or rounded statistics (BRD-01); several counters at once.
entries.build: Count with tabular figures and the final value in the DOM from the start. With prefers-reduced-motion: no movement, a plain state change.

entries.what: A vector animation made in a design tool and played on the page or in the app.
entries.use_when: Illustrated onboarding, empty states, success moments, an animated logo.
entries.avoid_when: Large files on the first screen; loops that never stop.
entries.build: lottie-web (MIT) or Rive runtime (MIT); lazy-loaded, paused off screen. With prefers-reduced-motion: no movement, a plain state change.
